title: Unsere Designelemente
slide_intent: Show how ingredients work together so designers can recognize a system beyond its logo.
strategic_value: The eight-item inventory can help DB preserve coherence as individual ingredients evolve.
demonstration: A two-row grid pairs eight visual specimens with descriptions of logo, sleeper, color, imagery, typography, layout, Signature Graphics and icons.
practical_value: Locate the ingredient guidance needed for a particular design decision.

content_islands.name: Ingredient grid
content_islands.spec: Pair each specimen with its role and link across two rows of four.

content_islands.name: System statement
content_islands.spec: Close beneath the grid with the explanation that the elements form a flexible system.

reference_purposes.Intent: The descriptions identify recognition, movement, information and orientation as jobs of the elements.
reference_purposes.Expression: The grid displays the mark, sleeper, palette, photographs, type and graphic families.
